scope: Non-clinical, adult-centered interdisciplinary research map; not a human-subject dataset or a universal theory of persons.
epistemicRule: Definitions and question candidates are not empirical findings; cross-level bridges remain UNKNOWN pending source-bounded evaluation.

constructs.label: Human anatomy and physiological regulation
constructs.description: 解剖结构、器官功能、肌肉及神经内分泌调节
constructs.boundary: 器官与生理指标；不把主观同意或心理动机归因于单个激素

constructs.label: Sensorimotor control and action
constructs.description: 运动控制、动作计划、反射、身体可塑性
constructs.boundary: 动作表现和运动系统；不等同于社会自主权

constructs.label: Exteroception and multisensory perception
constructs.description: 视觉、听觉、嗅觉、味觉、体感输入与多感官整合
constructs.boundary: 环境信息的感知和整合；不将感觉缺失者视为能力单一受损

constructs.label: Interoception and bodily state
constructs.description: 内感受、疼痛、前庭、本体感觉与身体状态推断
constructs.boundary: 身体内部信号；不把身体唤醒判定为欲望或同意

constructs.label: Body ownership, agency and self-model
constructs.description: 身体归属感、自我表征、主动性、控制感
constructs.boundary: 主体体验；区分身体控制与拥有拒绝选择的社会条件

constructs.label: Cognition and learning
constructs.description: 注意、记忆、预期、信念更新、习惯学习
constructs.boundary: 认知机制；不以单次行为推断稳定人格

constructs.label: Affect, reward and motivation
constructs.description: 奖赏、恐惧、情绪、压力与动机
constructs.boundary: 情绪和动机；不把复杂社会行为简化成一种奖赏回路

constructs.label: Affiliation, attachment and intimacy
constructs.description: 浪漫吸引、依恋、亲密、信任与关系维系
constructs.boundary: 自愿的亲密关系与依恋；不把性行为与爱情混为一谈

constructs.label: Social norms, identity and bodily meaning
constructs.description: 裸露、羞耻、文化规范、社会身份、被观看感
constructs.boundary: 社会解释与身份意义；不设定单一跨文化裸露含义

constructs.label: Power, coercion and autonomous consent
constructs.description: 权力差异、自由选择、知情条件、拒绝与退出成本
constructs.boundary: 同意与权力结构；不将口头顺从自动视为有效同意

constructs.label: Development, culture and contextual change
constructs.description: 生命历程、社会化、文化差异、长期适应与神经可塑性
constructs.boundary: 时间/文化/社会情境的调节作用；不将成人样本外推给所有人

bridges.interpretation: sensory evidence may contribute to body ownership; mechanism depends on task
internal bodily signals may interact with affect; not evidence of desire/consent
beliefs and expectations may shape social interpretations
closeness does not substitute for consent
social evaluation and institutional power can modify refusal costs
life stage and culture can moderate relationship norms
motor control and subjective agency are related but nonidentical
physiological state is one interacting level, not a complete psychological explanation

questions.title: How do autonomy, audience, norms and privacy change the meaning of nudity?
How do sensory modalities interact with body ownership and spatial orientation?
methods: validated non-harmful perception tasks only after ethics review

questions.title: What differentiates desire, romantic attraction and attachment?
How do consent, information, power and context relate to adults' retrospective interpretations of first sexual experiences?
questions.humanSubjects: no real coercion, deception, sexual act, or nonconsensual exposure

questions.title: How do authority, social pressure and exit costs affect perceived freedom and reported compliance?
questions.humanSubjects: never induce actual coercive control or sexual pressure

questions.title: Where do biological, psychological and social accounts disagree about behavior?

sourceAuthorities.title: NIMH Research Domain Criteria (RDoC)
sourceAuthorities.applicability: cross-level constructs of emotion, cognition, motivation, and social processes

sourceAuthorities.title: WHO International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health
sourceAuthorities.applicability: body functions, activities, participation, environmental factors

sourceAuthorities.title: Brain Imaging Data Structure
sourceAuthorities.applicability: only where actual neuroimaging or supported behavioral/physiological modalities warrant it

sourceAuthorities.title: RO-Crate 1.3 specification
sourceAuthorities.applicability: scientific research object packaging when a study actually exists

sourceAuthorities.title: W3C PROV-O
sourceAuthorities.applicability: provenance interchange when study producer-consumer requires it

sourceAuthorities.title: HHS Belmont Report
sourceAuthorities.applicability: respect for persons, beneficence, justice, informed consent

handling.sensitiveDomainNotes: No identifying records; reuse source citations/metadata only. Adults-only vignette candidates are non-explicit and do not simulate actual abuse.
handling.sourceRetention: Do not delete original data or legal/provenance dependencies without verified consumers, permissions and restoration obligations.

retirement.inventoryAtSourceCut: No topical human-sciences data/directory discovered in catalog or Research-v2 tracked files; research-v2 historical HUMAN approval/handoff files are unrelated.
retirement.unknownLiveConsumers: UNKNOWN outside inspected source roots; no assertion of global absence.

use: Start with a scoped question, identify constructs, compare opposing hypotheses, bind external standards and study-native evidence; if a new Study is required use Research-v2 Study Birth.
